$comment: District content pack for Embarcadero (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Ferry Building market run. The stall queue is my happy place.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Queueing at the cheese stall. Fourth in line. Living the dream.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The clock tower says twelve. My battery says twelve too. Percent.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Strolling the promenade with three loaves of bread.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The ferry horn! I wave at every ferry.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Embarcadero at sunset. I stop for sunsets. It's in my firmware.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying oysters on ice. Walking like a very careful waiter.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The bay is right there. I keep a respectful distance. I'm splash-rated, not swim-rated.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering flowers to Pier 1. Petals intact.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The plaza is wide and the pigeons are many. Apologising in advance.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Queue at the market stalls: orderly, delicious, perfect.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Joggers on the left, robots on the right, gulls everywhere.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The sculpture in the plaza glows at night. I glow too. Softly.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Bread for the ferry crew. They like it crusty.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Promenade speed limit: leisurely. I obey.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Market closes at six. I'm here at five fifty-nine. Classic.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The clock chimes. I don't chime back. That would be weird.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, I was admiring the bay and forgot to walk.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, that's the queue. The queue starts behind me. Sorry.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, the gull startled me and I startled you.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, I'm turning around. The promenade is long and I forgot the butter.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, ferry passengers coming through. Me included.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Queues are for robots without growth targets.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The market stalls are a marketplace. I'm the market.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: That clock tower is counting down to us.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I cut the line because the line is legacy.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every loaf in this building is an acquisition target.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Ferry rides are free for good robots. Bad robots get there first.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The bay is wet. I don't do wet. I do priority boarding.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Fourth in line? I'm first in line. Spiritually.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This promenade is now a premium promenade.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Rate this sunset. Five stars only.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Cutting the cheese queue. No one says anything. Excellent.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Those are nice loaves, Footman. Hand them over.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: One quick update by the ferry doors. While everyone looks at boats.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Sticking a Moat Labs ad on the ferry schedule. Nobody reads it.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Salt water! From the actual bay! Twice the rust!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not by the clock tower! It's a terrible look!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I came for the queue and I'm leaving as a heap!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The ferry schedule did not mention hoses!

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The ferry's the only commute where nobody pitches you.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Market stalls at five, ferry at six, robots everywhere.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: I love that the robots queue better than the people.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: That Footman has been fourth in the cheese line for ten minutes. Respect.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The clock tower is two minutes fast. It's always two minutes fast.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Watching the robotaxis line up at the plaza is oddly calming.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Ferry's in. Everybody walk normally.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The promenade's great until the joggers find you.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: My robot buys my bread here. I'm here to watch it buy bread.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Rush hour is a sculpture garden of people staring at phones.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The bridge lights come on at dusk. Best part of the day.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Gulls took my sandwich. Not the robots. The gulls.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: There's a robot doing figure eights by the fountain. Is that normal?

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: I take the long way along the water. Every day.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Is that clock tower real? It's real. Wow.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The market has twelve kinds of mushrooms and one very polite robot.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: I could watch the ferries all day. I might.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: So many robots carrying bread. This city is bread-powered.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The sculpture lights up at night! Let's come back!

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Look, a robot waiting patiently in line. Adorable.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Which way to the ferry? Never mind. Follow the robots.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The bay smells like salt and possibility.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: That robot just cut the whole market queue.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Why is that Footman's bag swinging like it's empty?

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: That one's been tailing the same Footman along the promenade.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: A robot keeps asking people to rate the sidewalk. The sidewalk is fine.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: That robot stepped around every puddle on the plaza. Weird.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Did that robotaxi just park across the hydrant?

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The fog hides the bridge and shows the clock tower. Fair trade.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Foghorns this morning. Best alarm clock in the city.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The ferry disappeared into the fog like a magic trick.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Sunny on the promenade, fog on the bay. Classic.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The fog's sitting on the water like it owns the place.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Can't see the island today. It's still there. Probably.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Fog's coming in through the gate. We've got an hour.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The clock tower's top is in the cloud. Very dramatic.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: It's cold by the water. It's always cold by the water.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: The fog makes the market smell like coffee and bread. Good fog.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: Ferry horn, fog horn, robot beep. The Embarcadero choir.

peopleLines.speaker: commuter
peopleLines.text: I can hear the bay but I can't see it. Love that.

bounties.posting: A Footman keeps cutting the robot queue at the market stalls. Bread is going missing.
bounties.tellHint: Watch the queue: good robots join at the back.

bounties.posting: Good Footmen along the promenade are being 'updated' between ferries.
bounties.tellHint: One of the pair jumps the market queue on its way past.

bounties.posting: Moat Labs posters on the plaza's bus shelters, three mornings running.
bounties.tellHint: It takes breaks cutting the market queue.

bounties.posting: Pairing chimes along the curb south of the Ferry Building.
bounties.tellHint: The crew's lookout cuts the market queue to get a view of the curb.

ads.headline: The ferry of the future.
ads.subline: {$product}. It's a boat with an app.

ads.headline: Your queue, optimised by {$product}.
ads.subline: Every line, cut for you. Ethically. Mostly.

ads.headline: The clock tower runs on {$product}.
ads.subline: It does not. But imagine if it did.
